blind.description: A stylized low-poly wooden danger sign consisting of three horizontal wood planks bolted onto two vertical wooden support posts. The front face features painted markings: a white stylized skull and a faded dark red 'X' cross. Dark round bolt heads secure the boards to the posts. The wood has a warm brown finish with soft bevelled edges. The structure stands directly on the cut ends of the two vertical posts.
blind.from_above: A thin vertical rectangular profile showing the tops of two square posts at the ends connected by horizontal planks, casting a long shadow to the left.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.8 feet (0.55 m) tall—reaching just below the knee of the 5 ft 9 in figure—and approximately 1.8 feet (0.55 m) wide.
